summary: Busy Moggill Road arterial kerb with clearway signs, no parked cars, steep.

drivers.seclusion: Homes 19 m to 40 m away on the same side; shops and school nearby.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb abuts live lanes with no lay-by or verge; clearway and bus zone signs.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb.

sun_shade: Mostly open; some tree shade from the south side.
